description: This file defines a Java class 'CrudHttpClient' that provides an HTTP client implementation using Vert.x for performing CRUD operations and HTTP requests such as OPTIONS, GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE. It is a test class intended for testing HTTP API interactions within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: CrudHttpClient
classes.description: A Vert.x-based HTTP client for invoking CRUD operations on HTTP APIs, supporting methods for OPTIONS, GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE requests, with success criteria via predicates.
